name: Ratatouille with baked cod
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and pepper in olive oil.
Add the diced aubergine and courgette and cook until tender.
Pour in the tinned tomatoes with thyme and simmer 15 minutes.
Season the cod fillet with salt and lemon.
Nestle the cod into the ratatouille and bake 12 minutes.
Serve the cod topped with the vegetables and pan juices.
